questions.prompt: How should v2 land in this repo?
questions.description: This determines branch layout, PR strategy, and whether v1 stays runnable during the rewrite.
questions.recommendedAnswer: New long-lived branch (e.g. v2) that replaces src/ in place; v1 tagged/archived on master before merge.

options.label: v2 branch replaces src/ in place; tag v1 on master first
Keep v1 and v2 side-by-side (e.g. src-v1/ + src/) until cutover
New git repo; lateralus becomes v1 archive only
Rewrite directly on master with no v1 tag/archive step

questions.prompt: What architectural foundation should v2 be built on?
questions.description: docs/interceptor-loop-implementation-plan.md already proposes a Pedestal-style interceptor chain as the single extension mechanism.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Interceptor chain engine (docs/interceptor-loop-implementation-plan.md) — ~100-line engine, everything (memory, LLM, tools, persistence) as interceptors/plugins.

options.label: Interceptor chain (proposed plan) — single extension mechanism
Traditional layered modules (cli → loop → llm → tools → memory) without interceptor engine
Layered modules internally, interceptor chain only at the agent loop boundary
Something else (describe in custom answer)

questions.prompt: Which v1 capabilities must v2 ship with at launch?
questions.description: Select all that apply. Unselected items are out of scope for the initial v2 release unless noted otherwise.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Core agent loop, CLI (interactive + one-shot + daemon), session memory (Datalevin + hybrid recall), remember tool, web-search, file editing (clj_edit + file_edit), Malli at network boundaries, uberjar build.

options.label: Core agent loop (LLM + tool dispatch + retries)
CLI: interactive, one-shot, daemon + PID file
Session memory (Datalevin + embeddings + hybrid recall)
remember tool (explicit facts)
web-search tool (HTML scraping providers)
File editing (clj_edit + file_edit + safety/backup)
repl-eval tool (in-process eval — security tradeoff accepted)
Portal visualize tool
nREPL server + tool integration
Uberjar + launcher script build
GraalVM native-image target

questions.prompt: Should v2 read existing v1 session data?
questions.description: v1 stores sessions under LATERALUS_SESSIONS_DIR with Datalevin schema documented in docs/memory-system-mvi.md.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Read v1 sessions in-place (same schema/paths) — no migration tool needed if schema unchanged.

options.label: Read v1 sessions in-place (same schema, same paths)
Provide a one-time migration command for v1 → v2 session format
Fresh start — v2 uses new session format; v1 sessions abandoned
Dual-read: v2 opens v1 stores read-only, writes to v2 format

questions.prompt: How compatible should the v2 CLI be with v1?
questions.description: README documents ~20 flags/env vars. Breaking changes affect scripts and muscle memory.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Same flags and env vars where behavior is unchanged; breaking changes only with documented migration notes.

options.label: Fully compatible — all v1 flags/env vars work identically
Mostly compatible — keep common flags; rename/remove obscure ones with notes
Clean-slate CLI — redesign flags from scratch, no compat guarantee

questions.prompt: Which iteration-1 mistakes must v2 explicitly fix?
questions.description: From arch audit (docs/arch-remediation-plan.md) and your experience. Select all that apply.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All listed items — these are the core reasons for a rewrite rather than incremental patches.

options.label: No god module — core/engine stays small (<200 LOC target)
All LLM calls through LlmClient protocol; no direct http/completion from loop
Malli validation on every external/network boundary (HTTP, embed, search)
External deps behind protocols with instrumented implementations
Sequential tool execution by default (no pmap without explicit opt-in)
Pick one extension style (protocol OR defmulti, not both ad hoc)
Single plugin/interceptor registration path — no ad-hoc add-*-tool! functions
Every namespace has tests before merge; no 500+ LOC untested modules

questions.prompt: What is explicitly OUT of scope for this rewrite goal?
questions.description: Helps prevent scope creep. Select all that apply.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Paid search APIs, repl-eval sandbox, multi-agent orchestration, and pi/Cursor SDK integration are follow-ups — not part of the v2 rewrite itself.

options.label: Replacing HTML scraping with paid search APIs
Sandboxing repl-eval (separate security initiative)
Multi-agent orchestration / intercom coordination
pi / Cursor SDK integration as first-class feature
Custom TUI beyond basic interactive CLI
Hosted/cloud deployment infrastructure
Nothing excluded — v2 should include everything selected above plus extras

questions.description: The acceptance bar for declaring the goal complete.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All selected launch features work; full test suite green; v1 arch audit items resolved; README + MVI docs updated; uberjar builds; old v1 src removed or archived.

options.label: Full bar: features + tests + docs + build + arch fixes + v1 archived
MVP bar: core loop + memory + CLI work; file tools and extras can follow
Parity bar: v2 matches all v1 README capabilities with cleaner architecture
Custom definition (describe)
